name: Kitsu
tagline: Anime and manga catalog API with community ratings and library tracking
description: Kitsu provides a JSON:API for anime, manga, characters, and user libraries. It is used to search titles, fetch metadata, ratings, episodes, and user-related library data for anime and manga applications.

auth.details: OAuth2 password or client credentials for write/user endpoints; many public catalog endpoints work unauthenticated. Register an OAuth application in account settings.

use_cases: get anime metadata and ratings by ID
list episodes for an anime series
look up manga titles and details
fetch character info linked to anime or manga
